setx.tos_intro: Last updated: {date}. {game} (the “Game”) is provided by {company} (“we”, “us”). By accepting, you agree to our {terms}, and our {privacy} explains how we handle your information. This page is a summary; the full text is at those two links.
setx.tos_p1: You must be at least {min} (or older where your local law says so) to create an account. If you are under {adult}, or under the age of majority where you live, you need a parent or guardian's permission and supervision; they must agree to these Terms with you and authorize any purchases.
setx.tos_p2: Keep your password private and do not share, sell or transfer accounts. Do not cheat, exploit bugs, use bots or unauthorized tools, or interfere with the Game or other players. We may restrict or suspend accounts that break the rules, and correct progress gained by cheating.
setx.tos_p3: No harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual content involving minors, spam, impersonation or other illegal or abusive content. Report a message from chat, block players (your Blocked players list is in Settings), or email {mail}. Do not put passwords, payment details or sensitive personal information in chat.
setx.tos_p4: Purchases in the Google Play version use Google Play Billing; the purchase screen shows the price and what you get before you confirm, and Google processes the payment. Diamonds, gold, heroes and other items are licensed for use in the Game, have no cash value and cannot be sold outside the Game. Refunds follow the law and the store's policy (Google Play's refund process); your statutory consumer rights still apply.
setx.tos_p5: Your account details (username, a salted password hash, a recovery email if you add one), your game saves and activity, chat messages and reports you send, purchase records, and technical data: IP addresses, connection times, device and app information, and error and security logs. We use it to run the Game, keep accounts secure and play fair, moderate chat, deliver purchases and fix problems. We do not sell your personal information. Other players see your name, castle, game activity and the chat you send them.
setx.tos_p6: Your account and saves are stored on our game servers and copied to backups for recovery. Routine technical, connection, IP and diagnostic logs are kept for {days}. Backups age out on their own rotation schedule.
setx.tos_p7: Use {del} in Settings, or the request form at {form}, or email {mail}. The account is locked and hidden for a {grace}; signing in within those {n} days cancels the deletion. After that our servers wipe it from our database. Backups are not erased at once - they age out on their own schedule. A guest profile with no password is deleted at once.
setx.tos_p8: The Game changes through updates and balancing and is provided “as is” to the extent the law allows. These Terms are governed by the laws of {law}; mandatory consumer rights where you live are not affected. We update the date above when the Terms change and ask you to accept again.

gloss.ab_note: Numbers at level 1. In the campaign and the Vault, an enemy's abilities grow {p}% stronger with every level.
gloss.ab_stunhit: Strikes its target for {dmg} and stuns them for {s} s.
gloss.ab_volley: Hits the {n} nearest heroes for {dmg} each.
gloss.ab_volley_one: Strikes the weakest hero within {r} m {n} times in quick succession, {dmg} each.
gloss.ab_nova: A blast around itself: {dmg} to every hero within {r} m.
gloss.ab_fireball: Hurls a fireball at the most crowded group of heroes: {dmg} to every hero within {r} m of the blast.
gloss.ab_fireball_wb: Hurls a fireball at your lowest-health back-row hero: {dmg} to every hero within {r} m of the blast.
gloss.ab_aoestun: Slams the most crowded group of heroes: {dmg} to every hero within {r} m, stunning them for {s} s.
gloss.ab_cleave: Sweeps a {a}° arc in front of itself: {dmg} to every hero within {r} m.
gloss.ab_aoedot: Burns every hero within {r} m of itself: {fx}.
gloss.ab_ashfall: Covers the most crowded group of heroes with a {r} m zone for {d} s: {p}% of {stat} every half second to every hero inside.
gloss.ab_mortal: Wounds its target for {dmg}; for {d} s that hero receives only half healing.
gloss.ab_devour: Bites its target for {dmg} and heals itself for {p}% of the damage.
gloss.ab_selfheal: Heals itself for {p}% of its max health.
gloss.ab_heal: Heals every ally for {p}% of their max health.
gloss.ab_lifesteal: For {d} s it heals for {p}% of the damage it deals.
gloss.ab_taunt: Forces every hero to attack it for {d} s while it takes {p}% less damage.
gloss.ab_pull: Drags the farthest hero to within {m} m of itself, holding them for {s} s.
gloss.ab_pull_near: Drags the nearest hero to within {m} m of itself, holding them for {s} s.
gloss.ab_knockpull: Knocks the nearest hero {k} m back, then drags the farthest hero to within {m} m of itself, holding them for {s} s.
gloss.ab_blink: Vanishes for 1 s, then reappears beside the lowest-health hero within {r} m and strikes them for {dmg}.
gloss.ab_flurry: {n} quick blows on its target, {dmg} each.
gloss.ab_magicrider: Each blow adds {p}% more as magic damage.
gloss.ab_pierce: Hurls a projectile at the farthest hero: {dmg} to every hero in its {w} m-wide path.
gloss.ab_charge: Charges the farthest hero: {dmg} to every hero within {r} m of where it lands, stunning them for {s} s.
gloss.ab_charge_path: Charges the farthest hero: every hero it passes is knocked {k} m aside and takes {pdmg}; the hero it reaches takes {dmg} and is stunned for {s} s.
gloss.ab_warcry: Roars: its damage rises {p}% for {d} s, and every hero within {r} m flees in fear for {s} s.
gloss.ab_crescendo: Sings a healing hymn: every ally heals {h} at once, then {hot}; each cast is 25% stronger than the last, up to 4 times.
gloss.ab_chant: Draws a {r} m circle over its allies; after {lead} s, every second for {d} s, allies inside heal {h} and heroes inside take {dmg}.
gloss.abp_deepfreeze: Every 5 s one random hero is frozen solid for {s} s.
gloss.abp_immolate: A burning aura: {p}% of {stat} every second to every hero within {r} m.
gloss.abp_lifesteal: Heals for {p}% of all damage it deals.
gloss.abp_unstoppable: Cannot be stunned, feared or moved.
gloss.abp_wrath: Its damage rises {p}% every 5 s, compounding for the whole fight.
gloss.abp_selfregen: Regenerates {p}% of its max health every second.
gloss.abp_tidereserve: Restores {p}% of its max health and {e} energy every second.
gloss.abp_momentum: Its attack speed rises {p}% for every second it fights, up to +{c}%.
gloss.abp_notthere: Every {s} s the next blow aimed at it simply misses; it heals for {p}% of the damage it deals.
gloss.abp_stardust: Every basic attack leaves a burn: {p}% of {stat} twice a second for 2 s.
gloss.abp_unwind: Every {s} s one ally is cleansed of a harmful effect.
gloss.abp_mirewall: The ally with the least health takes {p}% less damage from heroes; it takes {q}% of what that ally avoids itself and heals back half.
gloss.abp_hush: Every 5 s one random hero is silenced for {s} s.
gloss.abp_unstepped: Cannot be pulled, knocked back or moved by abilities.
gloss.abp_regen: Every ally, itself included, regenerates {p}% of its max health a second.
gloss.abp_packstats: +{p}% damage dealt and damage resisted for every summon it has alive.
